statement.zh: 将宝墩文化城址群简单写成三星堆「国家」的直线前身，证据链仍不完整；宜作文化序列对照而非定论。
statement.en: Treating Baodun walled sites as a simple linear ancestor of a Sanxingdui ‘state’ overreaches; keep as cultural-sequence comparison, not settled polity genealogy.

disclaimer: Hypothesis / scholarly model — not established fact. Labelled kind=hypothesis.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only. Second density pass D-2026-10-11-30; bibliographic details verified via WebSearch/catalogs; no invented page numbers/coordinates/forged images.
